name: Acting in the person's account as the AI's own body
vision_statement: What the AI says about a person's account is the account as it is now, and what it changed in the account is read back after the change, so the person can trust both.
opportunities: The Quest account is the AI's own consistent state, which opens questions beyond the parent solution: how the AI states what it can reach (inside the host, outside it, in the world now, or not reachable) and is held to that claim, how heavy work is handed to a deep runner within a fixed turn and cost bound and its result checked, how a file change is kept bounded to one folder and reversible, how one named change on an outside tool server is made only when an allowlist permits it, and who a new goal belongs to and whether an AI representative can take it over.
solution_coherence: act-as-the-body keeps what the AI says about a person's account true to the account and to what it changed in it. It changes the quest as the person asks through operate-a-quest and writes files inside one folder through write-files. It reads from the sources the person's work lives in through gather-evidence, and hands a new goal to the right owner through hand-off-a-goal. It claims only the reach that claim-reach grants. Heavy work is the job of run-deep-work. One named change on an outside tool server is the job of write-through-mcp.
